series.measurement_boundary: Publisher-defined IF-692 DC HPC meter. The release does not specify whether this meter includes cooling, other building loads, or only IT equipment; a whole-facility total is not established.
series.methodology_note: Publisher-reported hourly C3 data-center power. The column heading uses the word Energy, but each numeric cell and the chart y-axis explicitly use kW; values remain power, not kWh. MST/MDT labels are read from each timestamp cell's number format. Sub-millisecond spreadsheet round-off is normalized to the nearest hour, with original timestamps retained. The publisher does not specify whether timestamps mark interval start/end or whether values are hourly averages or instantaneous samples. Missing cells remain null. Historical snapshot through January 2026; no live telemetry, annual-to-hourly estimate, or whole-facility allocation.

series.measurement_boundary: IT equipment on the ESIF data center floor; excludes cooling and other building loads
series.methodology_note: Irregular approximately minute-spaced electrical meter samples are grouped into UTC hours. The arithmetic mean is published only with at least 45 numeric samples and no gap greater than 300 seconds, including both hour edges. Hours with duplicate publisher timestamps are withheld; conflicting readings are not resolved. Other incomplete hours also remain null. No filling, time-weighting, energy integration or whole-facility total is performed. These historical IT equipment readings do not include cooling, generator-heat allocations or tower-pump allocations.
series.time_basis: UTC hour bins derived from each publisher timestamp's explicit GMT offset; no inferred DST offsets
